practiceReport.name: Justin Herbert
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Veteran starter profile (7th NFL season, 98% snap share) — elevated Questionable active conversion (84%) & Wednesday maintenance tolerance.
factors: Remains in early stages of NFL 5-Step Concussion Protocol
practiceReport.beatComment: Herbert entered the NFL's concussion protocol following this past Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets, and the QB's pending absence from Wednesday's session gives him two more chances to officially log practice reps before for this weekend's game against New England. In his current absence, DJ Uiagalelei is next up for Los Angeles' signal-caller reps, with practice squad member Jake Browning available for a Week 12 elevation, if needed.

practiceReport.name: Brenen Thompson
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (WR) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
factors: Did Not Participate (DNP) on Wednesday; remains sidelined from practice
practiceReport.beatComment: Thompson has not played since the Chargers' Week 2 game with the Raiders. The wide receiver initially dealt with a quadriceps injury before sustaining a hamstring injury while still recovering. Thompson's long string of DNPs continues into Week 12 prep, and it appears there may be no end in sight.

practiceReport.name: Kendall Williamson
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Standard NFL positional availability baseline (78% Questionable conversion).
factors: Did Not Participate (DNP) on Wednesday; remains sidelined from practice

practiceReport.name: Daiyan Henley
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (87% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
factors: Did Not Participate (DNP) on Wednesday; remains sidelined from practice
practiceReport.beatComment: Henley did not play in the Chargers' Week 11 loss to the Jets due to his knee injury. The linebacker has not practiced since sustaining the injury after Week 10. If Henley cannot suit up for Sunday's game, Marlowe Wax and Troy Dye will likely see increased snap shares at inside linebacker next to Del'Shawn Phillips.

practiceReport.name: Deane Leonard
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (CB) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).

practiceReport.name: Keaton Mitchell
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (RB) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
practiceReport.beatComment: The running back was injured in last Sunday's loss to the Jets. If Mitchell needs to miss time, it would likely turn this frustrating three-way committee backfield into a more traditional two-man affair, with Omarion Hampton handling early-down work and Kimani Vidal spelling him in passing situations.

practiceReport.name: David Njoku
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Standard NFL positional availability baseline (78% Questionable conversion).
practiceReport.beatComment: The veteran tight end injured his shoulder in last Sunday's loss to the Jets but was able to return to the contest, finishing with two catches for 21 yards on four targets on 41.7 percent of the offensive snaps. It's possible Wednesday was a maintenance day.

practiceReport.name: Tuli Tuipulotu
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (83% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
practiceReport.beatComment: Tuipulotu appears to have sustained his ankle injury in the Chargers' Week 11 loss to the Jets. The outside linebacker will need to upgrade his practice participation in Thursday or Friday's session for a chance to suit up for Sunday's contest against the Patriots. If the 24-year-old must miss the game, Akheem Mesidor (ankle) or Caleb Murphy will likely start opposite Khalil Mack.

practiceReport.name: Akheem Mesidor
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Trench/box position (LB) — historically higher active rate through braced upper-body & ankle soreness (81% baseline).
practiceReport.beatComment: The rookie first-rounder is working through an ankle injury that he picked up during the first half of the Chargers' 27-24 loss to the Jets in Week 12. Mesidor has two more opportunities to practice in at least a limited capacity ahead of Sunday's contest against the Patriots.

practiceReport.name: Tarheeb Still
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (95% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
practiceReport.beatComment: Still did not play in the Chargers' Week 11 loss to the Jets due to an ankle injury he sustained in Friday's practice. The cornerback remains sidelined with the issue, leaving Deane Leonard and Genesis Smith as the early options at slot cornerback for Sunday's game against the Patriots.

practiceReport.name: Dalvin Tomlinson
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Trench/box position (DT) — historically higher active rate through braced upper-body & ankle soreness (81% baseline).
factors: Did Not Participate (DNP) on Wednesday (veteran maintenance profile, awaiting Thursday workload)
practiceReport.beatComment: Tomlinson likely sustained his knee injury in the Chargers' Week 11 loss to the Jets. The defensive tackle will likely need to return to practice by Friday's session for a chance to suit up for Sunday's game against the Patriots.

practiceReport.name: Trey Pipkins III
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Trench/box position (OT) — historically higher active rate through braced upper-body & ankle soreness (81% baseline).
factors: 21-day IR window open (Week 3); logged Full Participation in prior week's ramp
Requires formal 53-man roster activation prior to weekly NFL transaction deadline
practiceReport.beatComment: Pipkins had been on IR since late September before being activated Saturday. The veteran offensive lineman is now set to give the Chargers' offensive line a boost. Pipkins may work in a rotational role, as Logan Taylor is "locked in" at left guard, per Alex Insdorf of BoltBeat.com.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Trey Pipkins III
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Week 7 Bye excluded from NFL 4-game minimum count
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Pipkins had been on IR since late September before being activated Saturday. The veteran offensive lineman is now set to give the Chargers' offensive line a boost. Pipkins may work in a rotational role, as Logan Taylor is "locked in" at left guard, per Alex Insdorf of BoltBeat.com.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Branson Taylor
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Taylor is battling an ankle injury and was ruled out for the Week 10 meeting with Baltimore. Now on injured reserve, he will be required to miss at least four games before being eligible to return.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Alec Ingold
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Week 7 Bye excluded from NFL 4-game minimum count
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Per Noah Furtado of The Athletic, Ingold wasn't included on the Chargers' initial Week 6 injury report Wednesday before being a late addition on account of the shoulder issue. He'll be sidelined for at least the next four games, making him ineligible to play until Week 11 versus the Jets on Nov. 22. The fullback hadn't logged any carries and recorded three receptions for 35 yards on four targets through Los Angeles' first five games.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Derwin James Jr.
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: James missed the Chargers' three games prior to the Week 7 bye due to a hamstring injury. He suffered a setback in his recovery during Week 8 prep, which will require a stint on IR for the veteran safety. James is required to be sidelined for at least four games, so the earliest he can return is Week 12 against the Patriots on Sunday, Nov. 29. Tony Jefferson will continue to operate in an elevated role in the secondary in James' absence.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Isaiah World
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: 4-game minimum satisfied on Injured Reserve (Knee); awaiting 21-day practice window designation.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Rashawn Slater
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Week 7 Bye excluded from NFL 4-game minimum count
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Slater underwent ankle surgery Thursday after suffering a high-ankle sprain during Sunday's loss to the Seahawks. The left tackle will now need to miss at least four games on IR before the Chargers can return him to the active roster. With Slater out, Logan Taylor will be protecting Justin Herbert's blindside in the Chargers' Week 5 matchup against the Broncos.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Trevor Penning
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Week 7 Bye excluded from NFL 4-game minimum count
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Penning entered the league's concussion protocol following the Chargers' Week 4 loss to the Seahawks. He'll be required to miss at least four games, so Week 10 against the Ravens on Monday, Nov. 16 is the earliest that Penning can return.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Trey Lance
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Week 7 Bye excluded from NFL 4-game minimum count
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Lance has been on the Chargers' injury report since late September due to a groin issue. He suited up for each of the Chargers' last two games, but it appears his injury has regressed enough for him to warrant a stint on injured reserve. As such, Lance will be sidelined for at least four games, and the next time he can play is Week 10 against the Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 16. DJ Uiagalelei will be the Chargers' backup to Justin Herbert while Lance is sidelined.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Tyler Biadasz
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Biadasz's placement on injured reserve means the 2020 fourth-rounder will be sidelined for the entire 2026 season. He suffered multiple injuries to his left knee -- including his ACL -- during Tuesday's training camp practice. There was initial optimism that he would be available toward the tail end of the regular season, but Biadasz will now shift his focus toward being fully healthy for the 2027 campaign. Jake Slaughter figures to serve as the Chargers' starting center moving forward.
